description: This Java class 'PhotoManager' manages background thread pools for downloading and decoding images, specifically from Picasa, using thread pools, caching, and handler communication with the UI thread. It implements singleton pattern, handles task states, and manages resources for image processing in an Android app.

classes.name: PhotoManager
classes.description: Manages thread pools, caching, and UI communication for downloading and decoding images in an Android app.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PhotoManager.

methods.name: handleState
methods.description: Handles state updates for a given PhotoTask, updating cache and UI accordingly.

methods.name: cancelAll
methods.description: Cancels all ongoing download tasks by interrupting their threads.

methods.name: removeDownload
methods.description: Stops a specific download thread associated with a given PhotoTask and URL.

methods.name: startDownload
methods.description: Initiates download and decoding of an image for a given PhotoView, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: recycleTask
methods.description: Recycles a PhotoTask object for reuse.
